_help: Fill 'entries' only with official results. Each entry: rank, team, affiliation (or null), system, primary, secondary (object of metric name -> value), isBaseline (true for organiser reference rows). 'directions' holds per-direction primary scores for the matrix view, keyed by challenge language codes: { "bn-hi": 41.2, ... } using bn bh ch hi kn mg mt mr te. 'directionsLabel' says which system the per-direction scores belong to.
